policy.publish_authorization: Use existing explicit human authorization for the named account and final artifact; drafting or upload permission alone is insufficient.
policy.constraints: Read current platform editor/API rules at execution time. No universal hard-coded title, file-size, image-count or duration limits.
policy.unknown_outcome: Inspect remote content/status before retrying. Never assume a timeout means no post was created.

platforms.authentication: WECHAT_APP_ID and WECHAT_APP_SECRET in runtime environment; account API permissions and IP allowlist as required by WeChat

flow: Select the correct creator account
Choose image or video publishing
Upload files in manifest order
Set cover, title, caption and relevant topics
Inspect every card or playback and current editor validation
Publish only within user authorization; capture note ID and state
Open Write Article in creator center
Choose Markdown or rich text editor
Insert article and upload local illustrations
Check rendered code blocks, links and image captions
Set source/originality and category from actual rights and content
Save draft or publish as authorized; capture article URL and moderation state
Sign in with the intended AWS Builder ID
Use + then Create article
Populate required fields and illustrations
Preview rendering, examples and attribution
Save draft or publish as authorized
Wait for moderation and capture Manage Content state and article URL
Verify intended account and current account media/text capabilities
Use browser composer or configured official API connector
Upload and finish media processing before creating posts
Inspect text, link previews and image alt text
Create root post only when authorized then reply in order using returned IDs
Record each post ID; resume a partial thread without duplicating the root

external_api.auth: User-context OAuth; posting permissions and developer access required

flow: Use Video Channels Assistant and the intended channel login
Upload video and wait for processing
Set cover, description and available topic fields
Play opening, middle and end; inspect crop and audio
Apply originality or synthetic-content declarations only when applicable
Publish or save as authorized and capture channel content ID/status
Select intended account in creator center
Upload video and wait for processing
Set cover, text and relevant topics
Check safe areas, audio, current restrictions and declarations
Publish or save as authorized
Record moderation state and content identifier

external_api.note: Official video.create requires approved application scope and user authorization. No Douyin API uploader is bundled.

flow: Open creator center and Upload Video
Upload final MP4 and wait for processing
Set title, cover, category, tags and source/original status accurately
Preview playback and subtitle timing
Submit only as authorized
Capture draft/submission ID, moderation state and final BV/URL when available
Select intended channel in Studio or OAuth connector
Upload with visibility explicitly set to private unless public publication is already authorized
Set metadata, thumbnail, language and captions
Answer audience, altered/synthetic content and other declarations truthfully
Wait for processing and platform checks
Set authorized visibility/schedule and capture video ID, URL and actual privacy state

external_api.auth: User OAuth with an appropriate YouTube upload scope
external_api.note: No YouTube API uploader is bundled. Explicitly set status.privacyStatus; verify current quota, audit and account restrictions.
